title: Trace-class notation conditional on its construction
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]
and the coefficient
conventions of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions], $A=A_{E,n}$, $s=\Spec k$ (with scheme and morphism conventions of [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]), and let $X$ and $C$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes,
$K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], and
$c=(c_1,c_2):C\to X\times_sX$ the support map of an admissible
cohomological correspondence [def-trf-correspondence], with
fixed scheme
$F=\operatorname{Fix}(c)$ of [def-trf-fixed-scheme]. A
correspondence $u:Lc_2^*K\to Rc_1^!K$ is equivalently a section
$\widetilde u:A_C\to\mathcal H_c(K)$ of the
trace-class source of
[def-trf-trace-class-source]; its *Verdier trace class* is

$$
\operatorname{Tr}_c(u):
A\xrightarrow{\widehat u}
R\Gamma(C,\mathcal H_c(K))
\xrightarrow{\mathfrak t_{c,K}}
R\Gamma(F,\omega_{F,A})
$$

where $\widehat u$ is the image of $\widetilde u$ under the
global-sections adjunction
$\operatorname{Hom}_{D(C,A)}(A_C,\mathcal H_c(K))\cong
\operatorname{Hom}_{D(A)}(A,R\Gamma(C,\mathcal H_c(K)))$.
The displayed composite is identified with an element of
$\operatorname{Hom}_{D(F,A)}(A_F,\omega_{F,A})$ by the
global-sections adjunction, and $\mathfrak t_{c,K}$ is
the morphism of [lem-trf-trace-map-from-external-duality]. Here
$\omega_{F,A}$ is the
dualizing complex of
[def-trf-dualizing-complex].
Here $A_C,A_F$ are the constant coefficient sheaves of
[def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and $R\Gamma$ is ordinary
derived global sections as in [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology].
The global-sections identifications are the unit-object case of
[lem-pur-rhom-global-sections], using $R\mathcal Hom_A(A_T,M)\simeq M$
for $T=C,F$.
